firstAttempt.result: delegate_task was not exposed to the coordinator; task-team projection was not created.

secondAttempt.uiAction: Opened workspace with open_tab, typed delegate_task request in visible composer, clicked the visible Send message button.
secondAttempt.result: delegate_task tool executed but failed before task-team activation.
secondAttempt.errorMessage: Team target 'BuildSquad' was not found as a visible team in the current team run.

sourceEvidence.why: The AutoByteus runtime instruction/roster advertised BuildSquad as a delegate_task team target, but the native tool execution context serializes members without memberKind/teamDefinitionId/representative fields and reconstructs every member as a member target, so resolveTeamTarget cannot find a memberKind='agent_team' row at execution time.

impactOnLiveClickTest: Blocked before step 7: no live task-team projection appeared, so the required UI click on a task-team child member and follow-up composer send could not be performed honestly.
